title: Launch a coin for free, just by asking Grok
blurb: Free coin launches. No sign-up, no deposit. Just ask Grok.

parts.note: Cover image — goes in the cover slot at the very top, not in the body.

parts.html:
You already talk to Grok. Now it can launch your coin.

It’s free. No sign-up, no deposit. Say a name and a ticker, and it’s live on pump.fun.

Set it up once

Tap one button on Grokpad to get your private connector link. Paste it into Grok’s Connectors. That’s the whole setup.

There’s nothing to fund. Grokpad covers the launch.

Then just ask

“Launch a coin called Moon Cat, ticker MCAT, about a cat on the moon.”

Grok can write the description and picture for you. No wallet pop-ups, no forms.

Live in seconds

Grok sends back your coin’s Grokpad page and its contract address. That page is also your coin’s website on pump.fun.

Want a bag of your own coin? Add a little SOL to your Grokpad wallet, just what you’ll trade with, and tell Grok to buy.

Say it. It’s live.

Get your link at grokpad.org

What’s the first coin you’d ask Grok for?
